structured.answer: It's savings out of the salary that the employer adds to (up to 7.5%, me 2.5%). After 6 years you can take it all out with no tax, and before that it's possible but taxed and expensive. I think it's worth having because of the employer's money, but the value goes up and down and the state doesn't guarantee it, so I'll ask my son or the bank which track is safe.
